ellie: Confidential question. Im having repeated tense interactions with a peer on the platform team. Its affecting my focus; small things escalate in syncs. Can People Ops help with informal mediation and a short-term meeting-seat adjustment? Id prefer this not be widely posted.
marcus (People Ops): Thanks for raising this, @ellie. We can help with a confidential, informal mediation first. Two options: 1) a private 1:1 facilitated by People Ops with your manager present; 2) a short mediated conversation with both contributors and a neutral facilitator. Which do you prefer?
ellie: Id like option 1 to start (private facilitated 1:1). Also would like a temporary reassignment of my desk for quiet periods and to avoid ad-hoc pairing with that peer for 2 weeks.
sanjay (Manager): Im supportive of a 1:1. I can also block out "quiet-focus" hours on Ellies calendar and tell the team to route pairing requests through me for two weeks. Ellie, want to pick the blocked hours?
ellie: Thanks, Sanjay. Mornings 9:30
m1:30
m are best. Id like People Ops to facilitate the 1:1 tomorrow if possible.
marcus (People Ops): Noted. Ill set up a private intake call today to get details and coordinate the facilitator. Well log this as a confidential employee-relations intake; only People Ops and your manager will see the record unless you request otherwise. We dont open formal investigations unless requested.
mediations_bot: Action queued: ER-intake created for ellie (id: ER-2265432100). Notifications to People Ops and manager only.
sanjay (Manager): Ill update the team calendar and reroute pairing for the next 2 weeks. If anyone asks, Ill say Ellie is on a focused project block.
ellie: Appreciate the quick response. Also want to ensure this does not affect my performance review; Im worried about perceptions.
marcus (People Ops): Confirmed: intake/messaging is confidential and will not be used negatively in performance calibration. If any adjustments to deliverables are needed during the two-week period, well coordinate and document them privately with your manager. Closing loop: Ill DM the intake form link and confirm the 1:1 time.
ellie: Thank you. Ill watch for the DM and the calendar block.
